## SoftN RELEASE_TAG

### Downloads

| App | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| **SoftN Loader** | Desktop runtime for running `.softn` bundles |
| **SoftN Builder** | Visual IDE for creating SoftN applications |
| **Website** | The complete static softn.com (`softn-com-*.zip`): upload its contents to a web host's document root; `DEPLOY.md` inside explains the rest |

**Platforms:** Windows (.exe, .msi), macOS (.dmg), Linux (.AppImage, .deb)
